verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that with Cowork, Copilot can take on "bigger, multi-step tasks and deliver completed to-dos" and that users can "hand off repetitive work." Browse with Copilot also performs multi-step actions in Edge with checkpoints for sensitive actions. However, Browse is a supervised, watch-in-real-time flow rather than background work, and Cowork appears only as a single line with no detail on asynchronous execution or a review handoff. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that delegated tasks run autonomously in the background, a described flow for returning results for user review, depth on how Cowork works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
